## Summary

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SenderTransferPending` — an unexpired sender-transfer proposal already exists for the stream.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::proposing_again_is_refused_while_a_proposal_is_live_and_allowed_afterwards`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::proposing_again_is_refused_while_a_proposal_is_live_and_allowed_afterwards). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// SenderTransferPending — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
let first = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
let second = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .propose_sender_transfer(&f.sender, &id, &first, &1, &false);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_propose_sender_transfer(
        &f.sender, &id, &second, &2, &false
    )))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked proposing_again_is_refused_while_a_proposal_is_live_and_allowed_afterwards
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Cancel or wait for the existing unexpired sender transfer to expire before proposing another one.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer)
